info.uv: glTF convention (v = 0 is the TOP row of the image): load the .webp with texture.flipY = false
info.alpha: alpha: true → alpha-test at 0.5, render double-sided; colour is bled under the transparent texels (alpha there is 1/255, never 0)
info.tiles: tiles: true → UVs leave 0..1, use RepeatWrapping
info.origin: ground plants: root at the origin; water plants: y = 0 is the water surface; hanging: top attachment at the origin; solids: resting on y = 0, centred in X/Z, logs along X

banana (huge_banana_leaf_slpmfhp_4k_ue_high): NOT a mesh. The glTF is a 2×2 unit placeholder plane; the pack is a leaf atlas (4096×1024 px = 2×0.5 m scan, one leaf). Leaf clumps are built by this script from bent cards.
elephantear (elephant_ear_qfxkv2_1k): NOT a mesh, a texture atlas (0.86×0.86 m scan: two leaf blades and five stalks; BaseColor + separate Opacity). Plants are built by this script from cards.

vine (hanging_vine_tfwoxsh_1k_ue_low): NOT a mesh. The glTF is a 2×2 unit placeholder plane; the pack is a tileable 2×2 m ivy-leaf decal atlas with opacity. Hanging ribbons / a curtain are built by this script.

root (buttress_root_wdbncfq_1k_ue_low): NOT a mesh. The glTF is a 2×2 unit placeholder plane; the pack is a tileable 2×2 m bark SURFACE of a buttress root. The buttress shape is PROCEDURAL (made by this script), only its texture is the scan.

trunk (ficus_microcarpa_tree_trunk_wdjqbag_gltf_low): glTF raw data is centimetres, already +Y up (raw bounds [-61.8, -0.3, -60.0] .. [64.2, 187.2, 37.8]). The two wrapper nodes (Z-up→Y-up, then 0.01 scale with Y-up→Z-up) cancel to a plain ×0.01, giving +Y up in metres. One LOD only (4018 triangles).
